purpose: Requirements for /forge:start-implement: selecting plan tasks, implementing, reviewing and updating the plan with resumable state, error handling, final confirmation and executor agent contracts.
summary: Task selection and presentation by priority, with task group handling
Progress state persistence in the plan, resume after interruption, orchestrator as sole writer
Error handling: failed state, re-execution rules, reverting dependent implemented tasks
Orchestrator must understand the task before delegating to the executor agent
Completion only after final confirmation against acceptance criteria and design/requirement docs
Task groups: build-passing units, one review per group, completed together
Review request and result handling, parallel execution, executor agent constraints
Plan file format, TaskContext and TaskResult JSON data formats
Prohibition on changing design/requirement docs during implementation; post-completion commit flow
Non-functional requirement: contract-violating results never treated as success
tasks: Changing plan JSON update and state transitions
title: REQ-034 start-implement 要件定義書
